name: Power in Uldaman
label: Quest
description: Power in Uldaman: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Now that the demon has been removed, we must gain a power source. Unfortunately, the best power sources are usually the oldest and the hardest to get. It's neat how fate likes to take a bite out of you sometimes, isn't it?
So you're going to need to go to Uldaman and defeat the obsidian sentinel there. He's big, he's tough, and his power source packs a punch!
I wish you the best of luck, friend. And if you don't get lucky then, well... It was nice knowing you.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Have you been to Uldaman, friend? Did you defeat the obsidian sentinel?

clips.title: Completion
paras: I was chatting with some of my colleagues and when your name came up they said, "You know that friend sure works well under stress!"
But when I told them I sent you to Uldaman against the obsidian sentinel, they said I was crazy! They said, "Tabetha, you're crazy! There's no way friend could take on that sentinel!"
And I said, "We'll see," and then they said "Yeah, we'll see..."
Well we sure showed them, didn't we!
